text:
Priya (Product): Quick async Q3 OKR milestone check-in — please post what shipped, what slipped, owners, and any blockers. I’ll compile for leadership. :wave:

Devin (Eng Infra): Autoscaler autoscale policy change shipped to prod yesterday. Throughput/resilience verified in canary.

deploy-bot: canary rollout complete for autoscaler-v2 — 3/3 healthy. Logs: /deploys/1749532099

Alex (Eng Runtime): Runtime quantization PR merged (PR #842). Noticed perf regression on long-context (>4096) cases in our harness. Marking this as slipped for the quarter. Owner: Alex. Blocker: deeper profiling needed. @Sam can you pair on reproducing the regression?

Sam (Eng ML): On it. Spinning up perf harness now, will run long-context sweep and post results. ETA EOD today.

Lina (Product Ops): Dedicated pricing doc update shipped to docs site — PR merged. Link: https://docs/redwood/dedicated/pricing

Priya (Product): Thanks. For the runtime perf slip, proposal: temporarily route long-context requests to runtime-v1 until perf fix is validated. @Devin can you add a short-lived routing rule? :thinking:

Devin (Eng Infra): Yes — can add a routing rule. Draft config below, will hold behind Sam's staging signoff:
```yaml
route:
  matcher: 'sequence_length > 2048'
  target: runtime-v1
  ttl: 1h
  reason: 'temporary fallback for quantization perf regression'
```

Sam (Eng ML): Ran staging perf sweep — v2 shows ~12% slower tail latency at 8k tokens. Staging tests passed otherwise. Approving route to limit customer impact.

Chris (Product): Any external customer exposure so far? Need to decide if we send a heads-up.

Priya (Product): Only internal beta saw the regression so far. If routing stays >72h or we see user escalations, we'll send a brief note. Action: @Lina to draft comm.

Lina (Product Ops): Drafted customer note and copied support. Will post to Dedicated customers if we keep fallback. Support ticket queued.

support-bot: ticket #3245 created — subject: "Runtime v2 long-context perf regression" — assigned to Alex, priority: P2

Alex (Eng Runtime): Thanks — I'll start profiling flamegraphs and stats today. If I can't find the hotspot by EOD tomorrow, I'll open a follow-up spike and update OKR status.

Priya (Product): OK — concise summary to paste into the OKR board:
- Shipped: Autoscaler changes (owner: Devin), Dedicated pricing doc (owner: Lina) :white_check_mark:
- Slipped: Runtime quantization perf for long-context (owner: Alex) :warning:
- Blockers: need profiling + perf validation (Alex + Sam)
- Actions: Alex -> profiling and fix, Sam -> perf regression validation, Devin -> add temporary route (ttl 1h rolling), Lina -> customer comms if >72h or escalations.

Priya (Product): I'll update the OKR card and ping leadership after Alex posts profiling updates. Thanks everyone — small async check but useful. :pray:
